content.rendered:
Please click on the following link for the Archer Glen Kinder through 5th grade supply list for 2017-2018 – EAGLES

Note that you will only purchase from Page 1 OR Page 2. The two lists were created for the parents ease in purchasing supplies for those with one child or those with multiple children at Archer Glen.
Supply Night will be Thursday, August 31st from 4:00 – 6:00 pm. For those families new to Archer Glen and Sherwood School District, all Sherwood elementary schools host an open house Supply Night where students can meet their teacher and classmates and bring in their school supplies. This helps to make the first day of school less stressful for families.
